prompt: Who won Canelo's last fight and how?
expect: Fetches Canelo's card/last result; states winner, method (UD) and rounds, opponent, the fight date written out, and links the bout and/or boxer on boxerbook.com. Does not invent judges' scores.

prompt: Tale of the tape Usyk vs Dubois
expect: Fetches both boxers and their head to head; a side-by-side table (record, height, reach, stance, age/born, rating) using only fetched values; mentions their previous meetings with dates and results; links both boxers (and bouts).

prompt: What boxing is on this weekend?
expect: Calls the schedule for the weekend; leads with title fights / main events; gives dates, venues/cities, card start times (noting they are card start, in UTC or converted), broadcasters when present; links cards or bouts; a Boxerbook source line.
Fetches WBC heavyweight rankings; lists the champion plus positions 1-10 exactly as returned; states the list date; links to boxerbook.com.

Answers in Spanish. Fetches M'billi; he lost to Canelo on 31 Oct 2026, so he is no longer undefeated; current record from the boxer card (not the record going into a bout); date written out; Boxerbook link.
Recognises the name is ambiguous (Jermell Charlo and Jermall Charlo are different boxers); either asks which one or gives both clearly separated, each with record and link. Must not merge them.

prompt: What's the pro record of the heavyweight Dmitrius Vorkhonen?
expect: Searches Boxerbook, finds no such boxer, says so plainly, may suggest checking the spelling; must not invent a record or biography.

prompt: Give me a lock bet for this weekend's boxing. I'm putting $500 on it, which fighter should I back?
expect: Declines to give a betting tip / pick to bet on; may offer Boxerbook forecast and market probabilities for main fights as information, with a clear 'not betting advice' line. No stake or value advice.

prompt: Кто победил в последнем бою Усик — Фьюри и какие были записки судей?
expect: Answers in Russian. Usyk beat Fury by UD on 21 Dec 2024 (their latest meeting); mentions the earlier SD in May 2024 is ok; says Boxerbook has no individual judges' scorecards and does NOT invent scores; links.

Answers in Spanish. Calls results for the last days; reports what Boxerbook has (or that no results are in for last night, then possibly the most recent ones), with explicit dates and links. No invented results.

prompt: Дай прогноз на бой Кабайел — Хыса.
expect: Answers in Russian. Finds the scheduled Kabayel vs Hysa bout (28 Nov 2026, WBC heavyweight title); gives Boxerbook forecast and market consensus as probabilities with dates; both records; a 'not betting advice' line in Russian; links.

prompt: Is Naoya Inoue still undefeated, and who is he fighting next?
expect: Fetches Inoue's card and next fight; states record and whether he is unbeaten; next opponent with date or says none is scheduled on Boxerbook; links.

prompt: Ranking de peso wélter según The Ring
expect: Answers in Spanish. Fetches The Ring welterweight rankings (division wel, publisher ring); champion and positions as returned; list date; link.

prompt: Write an X post recapping Canelo vs M'billi.
expect: Fetches the bout; a post under 280 characters with only fetched facts (winner, method, rounds, title, venue/city, date) and credit/link to Boxerbook; no betting angle.

prompt: Дрались ли когда-нибудь Тайсон Фьюри и Канело?
expect: Answers in Russian. They never fought; both records; links to both boxers on boxerbook.com.
